name: Integrated run request payload
producer: Frontend integrated scenario definition form or API client
schema_or_key_columns: energy_scenario_key; mrio_scenario_id; target_year; run_profile; levers.{demand_multiplier,renewables_capex_multiplier,fossil_fuel_price_multiplier,carbon_price_usd_per_tco2}; strict_validation; allow_placeholder_data
units: dimensionless lever multipliers; USD/tCO2 carbon price; calendar year
temporal_resolution: single target_year plus run_profile time-slice behavior
spatial_resolution: scenario geography inherited from selected MRIO scenario and Calliope energy locations
sector_technology_resolution: energy pathway key plus MRIO report scenario id
validation_rules: Pydantic forbids extra fields; validates target_year 1900-2200; profile is dev/analysis/full; levers have numeric bounds; analysis/full force strict_validation true
interpretation_notes: This is now the required upstream contract. It replaces the older single scenario field and builds one IntegratedScenarioPackage that feeds energy, bridge, and MRIO-direct layers.
quality_caveats: Request validity does not guarantee scientific validity; strict_validation and allow_placeholder_data determine whether placeholder expert datasets can pass.
expert_action_required: Keep frontend and API clients aligned to this exact shape; do not reintroduce separate energy/MRIO run modes.

name: Integrated scenario catalog response consumed by UI
storage_scope: API response used as input by frontend
generated_or_manual: Generated at request time from repo inputs
lifecycle: Dynamic catalog, deterministic for current repo inputs
schema_or_key_columns: schema_version; energy_scenarios[]; mrio_scenarios[]; target_years[]; geography_alignment_options[]; report.source_file; report.source_sha256; defaults
temporal_resolution: available target years parsed from report; default target_year 2030
spatial_resolution: MRIO geography codes; Calliope locations in mapping rows
sector_technology_resolution: energy scenario metadata and MRIO scenario summaries
source_or_provenance: Calliope overrides plus scenario metadata plus parsed report plus geography mapping
placeholder_status: None; reports availability of scenario choices
validation_rules: Must include valid energy_scenarios, MRIO scenarios, target years, defaults; report scenarios should include ZA-S1, ZA-S2, IN-S1, IN-S2, BR-S1, BR-S2, WF-S1, WF-S2, WM-S1, WM-S2
interpretation_notes: This is the single setup catalog for the app. It intentionally presents energy pathway and MRIO-direct report scenario as parts of one integrated scenario definition.
quality_caveats: Catalog completeness depends on successful DOCX parsing and mapping table correctness.
expert_action_required: Check scenario labels and defaults with product/design before external demos.

name: Energy modelling scenario report
lifecycle: Source of truth until replaced by structured scenario database
schema_or_key_columns: report tables and text parsed into scenario_id; geography; label; summary targets; target_years; shock_categories.{A/Z,E,Y}; source_notes; calibration_notes
spatial_resolution: ZA, IN, BR, WF, WM report geographies; may be national or regional
sector_technology_resolution: MRIO sectors/parameters inferred from A/Z, E, Y shock guidance
source_or_provenance: Root repository document authored outside the app
placeholder_status: May contain narrative assumptions not directly machine-executable
validation_rules: Parser must recover all 10 scenarios; source SHA256 cache invalidates when DOCX changes
interpretation_notes: The report provides MRIO-direct assumptions outside the energy model boundary. Parsed content should not be treated as solved energy output.
quality_caveats: DOCX tables and prose can be ambiguous; parser extraction should be analyst-reviewed after report edits.
example_values: ZA-S1, ZA-S2, IN-S1, IN-S2, BR-S1, BR-S2, WF-S1, WF-S2, WM-S1, WM-S2
expert_action_required: Keep report structure table-like and explicit; if scenarios change, verify parser test fixtures and generated JSON.

name: Parsed scenario report cache
consumer: scenario_package catalog/package builder and MRIO-direct adapter
generated_or_manual: Generated from DOCX and cached by SHA256
schema_or_key_columns: source_file; source_sha256; scenario_ids[]; scenarios.{scenario_id}.geography_code; geography; scenario_type; label; description; target_years; summary; shock_categories; source_notes; calibration_notes
units: percentages; text notes; normalized numeric target proxies where parser can infer them
spatial_resolution: report geography code, not necessarily Calliope location
sector_technology_resolution: A/Z structural shocks, E emissions proxy shocks, Y final-demand proxy shocks
source_or_provenance: Derived from Energy Modelling Scenario Report.docx
placeholder_status: Not placeholder if parsed from report; heuristic interpretation still requires review
validation_rules: Cache SHA must match DOCX; must contain all expected scenario ids; malformed or missing scenarios should fail strict setup
interpretation_notes: Machine-readable bridge from narrative report to run-time MRIO-direct inputs.
quality_caveats: Extraction is only as reliable as the DOCX structure and parser heuristics; numeric fields may encode text-derived targets.
expert_action_required: After report edits, inspect this JSON and update parser rules if any key assumptions are missed.

name: Energy scenario metadata
required: Yes for polished UI; energy keys can still originate from overrides
schema_or_key_columns: key; title; description; tags; user_label; policy_question; baseline_scenario; expected_tradeoff; demand_multiplier; renewables_capex_multiplier; fossil_fuel_price_multiplier; carbon_price_usd_per_tco2
spatial_resolution: global scenario metadata; applies to selected energy scenario
source_or_provenance: Curated metadata aligned to Calliope overrides.yaml scenario keys
placeholder_status: May include illustrative labels, but not scientific model coefficients beyond preset levers
validation_rules: Keys should overlap Calliope overrides; lever values numeric if present; empty preset fields ignored
interpretation_notes: Controls how energy pathways are presented and can pre-populate lever defaults.
quality_caveats: Mismatch with overrides hides or degrades scenario labeling.
expert_action_required: Review policy question and expected tradeoff text for decision-maker clarity.

name: Lever mappings
schema_or_key_columns: key; value. Keys define renewables_techs, fossil_techs, demand technology selectors, and other lever-to-Calliope mapping values
temporal_resolution: run target applies through scenario override, with time subset controlled by profile
spatial_resolution: applies to technologies/locations matched by Calliope selectors
source_or_provenance: Curated mapping from UI levers to Calliope tech/cost/resource fields
placeholder_status: Not placeholder if selectors match current model; can silently under-apply if model names drift
validation_rules: Must parse as key/value; referenced tech selectors should exist in merged Calliope tech library
interpretation_notes: Determines how user levers become runtime override patches, including demand multiplier and cost/fuel/carbon price controls.
quality_caveats: High impact: stale mappings can make UI levers appear active while not changing model behavior.
update_frequency: When Calliope technologies or controls change
expert_action_required: Energy expert should verify selectors after every Calliope model library update.

name: Development model configuration
required: Yes for calibrated runs; built-in defaults exist but should be expert reviewed
schema_or_key_columns: parameter; value. Nested dotted keys can override surrogate, mario, and mario_direct config values
units: dimensionless shares, sensitivities, relative uncertainty bounds, ratios
temporal_resolution: run-level; uncertainty and heuristic scale apply to target run
spatial_resolution: global configuration, applied to all regions unless parameter-specific logic says otherwise
sector_technology_resolution: MRIO-direct, surrogate and runtime calibration parameters
source_or_provenance: Expert calibration file layered over backend defaults
placeholder_status: May still include default/proxy coefficients if not expert-calibrated
validation_rules: Values must be parseable numbers or structured keys accepted by loader; strict validation surfaces placeholder problems in related MARIO inputs
interpretation_notes: Controls fallback/surrogate coefficients, MARIO uncertainty bounds, and MRIO-direct heuristic scale/capping.
quality_caveats: If unreviewed, model quality should not be interpreted as production-grade even if software runs.
expert_action_required: Development/MRIO expert should replace default coefficients with documented empirical sources.

name: Scenario geography mapping
lifecycle: Static mapping updated when geographies change
schema_or_key_columns: mrio_geography_code; calliope_country_code; calliope_location; alignment_level; notes
spatial_resolution: MRIO geography to Calliope country/location, including national-to-subnational fan-out and regional-to-country/location fan-out
source_or_provenance: Curated alignment contract between report/MRIO and Calliope model locations
placeholder_status: Not placeholder if reviewed; currently critical for regional filter correctness
validation_rules: National MRIO may fan out to Calliope subnational groups; regional MRIO may fan out to mapped countries/locations; blocking only when both sides have incompatible subnational groupings without mapping
interpretation_notes: Determines where MRIO-direct assumptions apply relative to energy model locations.
quality_caveats: Incorrect mapping causes apparently precise regional outputs to be allocated to wrong places.
expert_action_required: GIS and model experts should audit every mapping row and notes field.

name: Calliope model root
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope model imports; run settings; model time; locations/tech/carriers references
temporal_resolution: model time horizon and subset_time profile controls
spatial_resolution: Africa model locations/power pools from imported YAML
placeholder_status: Not placeholder by itself; imported data may require expert review
validation_rules: Must be parseable by installed Calliope version; imports must resolve inside Calliope root
interpretation_notes: Top-level model contract for optimization. Runtime overrides patch it but should not mutate source.
quality_caveats: Calliope version compatibility is a risk; model units must be interpreted from Calliope config.
example_values: import: overrides.yaml, technology files, pool constraints
expert_action_required: Energy modeler should maintain imports and units documentation.

name: Calliope energy scenario overrides
consumer: scenario catalog and Calliope model build
schema_or_key_columns: scenarios.<energy_scenario_key> override definitions
spatial_resolution: Calliope locations and techs referenced by scenario
placeholder_status: Not placeholder if scenario definitions are reviewed
validation_rules: Scenario keys must be loadable; selected energy_scenario_key must exist
interpretation_notes: Defines the energy pathway side of the integrated package.
quality_caveats: Scenario names and metadata must remain synchronized with inputs/scenario_metadata.csv.
expert_action_required: Energy modeler should document each scenario’s physical/policy meaning.

name: AC demand scenario override
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope override keys for demand assumptions
temporal_resolution: model time horizon or profile subset
placeholder_status: Unknown; should be reviewed as scenario assumption
validation_rules: Must parse as YAML and match Calliope schema
interpretation_notes: Represents alternative demand assumptions used by scenarios.
quality_caveats: If demand scenario is not linked to selected override, it has no effect.
expert_action_required: Energy expert should document demand source and calibration year.

name: STEPS demand scenario override
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope override keys for STEPS demand assumptions
temporal_resolution: model time horizon or profile subset
placeholder_status: Unknown; should be reviewed as scenario assumption
validation_rules: Must parse as YAML and match Calliope schema
interpretation_notes: Represents a separate demand scenario, likely aligned to an external STEPS-style pathway.
quality_caveats: Needs provenance if used for policy comparison.
expert_action_required: Energy expert should provide source citation and scenario definition.

name: New generation location override
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope location/technology deployment constraints
validation_rules: Must reference valid locations and techs
interpretation_notes: Controls where new generation can be built or represented.
quality_caveats: Spatial assumptions here can drive map outputs and regional impacts.
expert_action_required: Energy/GIS expert should verify spatial granularity and centroid mapping.

name: New generation scenario override
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope tech build/cost/resource constraints
validation_rules: Must parse and reference valid tech/location/carrier names
interpretation_notes: Controls generation expansion assumptions in energy scenarios.
quality_caveats: May overlap conceptually with MRIO-direct renewable assumptions; headline overlap policy defaults to bridge for now.
expert_action_required: Energy expert should check costs/capacity constraints against current data.

name: New transmission links scenario override
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope transmission link definitions and constraints
validation_rules: Link endpoints and tech names must exist
interpretation_notes: Controls network expansion/new interconnection scenario behavior.
quality_caveats: Important for regional trade and reliability diagnostics; errors can create misleading pool-level outputs.
expert_action_required: Energy/transmission expert should verify line capacities/costs and endpoints.

name: Policy scenario override
schema_or_key_columns: policy constraint overrides; costs; emissions; resource limits as defined in YAML
validation_rules: Must parse and match Calliope schema
interpretation_notes: Encodes energy-system policy assumptions.
quality_caveats: Policy effects may overlap with MRIO-direct scenario narrative; keep provenance explicit.
expert_action_required: Policy/energy expert should define policy counterfactual and baseline clearly.

name: Power-pool location constraints
schema_or_key_columns: locations.<country/subregion>.tech constraints; resource/capacity/cost constraints
temporal_resolution: model horizon and time series references
validation_rules: Location keys must align with mapping and time series; YAML must parse
interpretation_notes: Defines spatial resolution and technology feasibility for each African power pool.
quality_caveats: Any mismatch here affects geographic filtering, Voronoi subregion mapping, and MRIO alignment.
expert_action_required: Energy/GIS experts should maintain one authoritative location dictionary.

name: Power-pool transmission links
schema_or_key_columns: transmission techs and location pairs; capacities; costs; efficiencies
validation_rules: Link endpoints must resolve to locations; parameters must match Calliope schema
interpretation_notes: Defines existing or candidate transmission topology.
quality_caveats: Network assumptions drive trade_matrix diagnostics and can dominate regional results.
expert_action_required: Transmission expert should verify with latest interconnector data.

name: Generation technology library
consumer: Calliope model imports; tech-sector bridge mapping validation
schema_or_key_columns: techs.<tech>.essentials/constraints/costs; carrier definitions
units: Calliope-native capacity, efficiency, cost, emissions units
temporal_resolution: model horizon with time-varying resources where linked
validation_rules: Technology names should be covered by calliope_tech_to_mario_sector.csv and lever_mappings.csv
interpretation_notes: Defines physical and economic behavior of generation technologies.
quality_caveats: Stale tech names break mapping coverage and development impact attribution.
expert_action_required: Energy expert should update bridge mapping and lever mapping simultaneously.

name: Transmission and demand technology library
consumer: Calliope model imports; tech-sector bridge mapping validation
schema_or_key_columns: transmission and demand tech definitions; constraints; costs
validation_rules: Technology names should be covered where development bridge expects them
interpretation_notes: Defines demand and grid technology behavior.
quality_caveats: Demand technology naming is important for demand_multiplier application.
expert_action_required: Energy expert should validate demand resource selectors and transmission cost mappings.

name: Demand time series
schema_or_key_columns: timestamp/index plus demand columns as expected by Calliope resource references
temporal_resolution: hourly or model-native timestep; dev/analysis may subset
spatial_resolution: per location or demand profile depending file structure
source_or_provenance: External demand dataset embedded in model files
placeholder_status: Unknown; should cite source and base year
validation_rules: Must align with Calliope resource file references and time index
interpretation_notes: Primary electricity demand driver. Runtime demand_multiplier scales Demand_power resource profiles after model build.
quality_caveats: Bad demand data propagates into all energy, emissions, cost, and development outputs.
expert_action_required: Energy demand expert should verify forecast methodology and load shape.

name: Solar resource time series
schema_or_key_columns: timestamp/index plus solar resource columns expected by model
units: capacity factor or resource availability, Calliope-native
source_or_provenance: External resource dataset embedded in model files
validation_rules: Must align with resource references and time index
interpretation_notes: Constrains solar generation availability.
quality_caveats: Resource data quality strongly affects optimal capacity and regional allocation.
expert_action_required: Energy resource expert should document source, year, bias correction, and spatial aggregation.

name: Wind resource time series
schema_or_key_columns: timestamp/index plus wind resource columns expected by model
units: capacity factor or resource availability, Calliope-native
source_or_provenance: External resource dataset embedded in model files
validation_rules: Must align with resource references and time index
interpretation_notes: Constrains wind generation availability.
quality_caveats: Spatial aggregation and turbine assumptions affect regional results.
expert_action_required: Energy resource expert should document source, hub height, and spatial aggregation.

name: Hydro resource time series
schema_or_key_columns: timestamp/index plus hydro resource columns expected by model
source_or_provenance: External resource dataset embedded in model files
validation_rules: Must align with resource references and time index
interpretation_notes: Constrains hydro generation availability and seasonality.
quality_caveats: Hydrological assumptions can dominate reliability and emissions outcomes.
expert_action_required: Hydro/resource expert should validate historical year and climate assumptions.

name: New PV candidate profile
schema_or_key_columns: timestamp/index plus PV candidate resource profiles
source_or_provenance: External resource dataset embedded in model files
validation_rules: Must align with model references
interpretation_notes: Supports new PV generation candidate behavior.
quality_caveats: If generic profile is overused, subnational PV differences may be understated.
expert_action_required: Resource expert should verify spatial representativeness.

name: New CSP candidate profile
schema_or_key_columns: timestamp/index plus CSP candidate resource profiles
source_or_provenance: External resource dataset embedded in model files
validation_rules: Must align with model references
interpretation_notes: Supports new CSP candidate generation behavior.
quality_caveats: CSP resource and storage assumptions need explicit documentation.
expert_action_required: Resource expert should verify DNI and thermal storage assumptions.

name: Calliope tech to MARIO sector mapping
consumer: runner bridge builder and mapping quality validator
schema_or_key_columns: calliope_tech; carrier; tech_group; mario_sector; shock_channel; default_currency; notes
spatial_resolution: technology rows may later map to MARIO regions through shocks
placeholder_status: Can contain fallback or placeholder rows depending notes/source; strict quality checks count missing techs
validation_rules: Every required Calliope tech should map; shock_channel should be recognized; missing techs become fallback warnings/errors under strict validation
interpretation_notes: Determines supplier-sector attribution for investment and operating shocks.
quality_caveats: Incomplete mapping directly distorts jobs/GVA by supplier sector.
update_frequency: Whenever Calliope tech library or MRIO sector taxonomy changes
expert_action_required: MRIO expert should align sectors to actual MARIO database taxonomy.

name: Calliope cost to MARIO account mapping
lifecycle: Static mapping updated with cost classes
schema_or_key_columns: calliope_cost_class; calliope_component; mario_account; mario_flow_type; sign_convention; notes
units: cost account labels and sign conventions
spatial_resolution: global/account-level unless paired with location shock rows
validation_rules: Cost classes/components must match summary_diagnostics cost decomposition
interpretation_notes: Maps energy model costs into MRIO accounts and flow types.
quality_caveats: Wrong sign conventions invert development impact shocks.
expert_action_required: MRIO/accounting expert should verify sign and account semantics.

name: CAPEX sector split table
consumer: runner bridge builder and strict validation
schema_or_key_columns: calliope_tech; mario_region; mario_sector; share; notes; tech_group
spatial_resolution: MARIO region; may be global/fallback by row design
sector_technology_resolution: Calliope tech to one or more supplier sectors
validation_rules: Shares should sum to 1 by calliope_tech/mario_region group where applicable; invalid groups are strict-validation issues
interpretation_notes: Allocates capital spending across supplier sectors for investment shocks.
quality_caveats: Bad splits distort sectoral jobs/GVA and regional import leakage.
expert_action_required: MRIO expert should replace proxy splits with empirically grounded sector shares.

name: OPEX sector split table
consumer: runner bridge builder and strict validation
schema_or_key_columns: calliope_tech; mario_region; mario_sector; opex_type; share; notes; tech_group
sector_technology_resolution: Calliope tech and OPEX type to supplier sectors
validation_rules: Shares should sum to 1 by calliope_tech/mario_region/opex_type group where applicable
interpretation_notes: Allocates fixed/variable operating spend across supplier sectors.
quality_caveats: Bad splits distort ongoing operational impact estimates.
expert_action_required: MRIO expert should validate against O&M cost structures and local content assumptions.

name: Country to pool/MARIO region mapping
lifecycle: Static mapping updated with geography changes
schema_or_key_columns: calliope_location; power_pool; mario_region; notes
spatial_resolution: Calliope location to power pool and MARIO region
validation_rules: Every exchange shock location should resolve to a MARIO region; missing rows can produce UNKNOWN/fallback regions
interpretation_notes: Maps Calliope locations to regions for bridge shock attribution.
quality_caveats: Earlier UNKNOWN-region issues come from this class of mapping gap; maintain carefully.
update_frequency: When Calliope locations or MARIO regions change
expert_action_required: GIS/MRIO experts should validate all locations and no UNKNOWN rows remain.

name: Employment intensity table
lifecycle: Static calibration table, should cite source year
schema_or_key_columns: mario_region; mario_sector; jobs_per_musd_direct; jobs_per_musd_total; reference_year; source; notes
temporal_resolution: reference_year plus run target year assumption
placeholder_status: Strict-blocking if placeholder rows and allow_placeholder_data=false
validation_rules: Numeric intensities required; jobs_total should be >= jobs_direct; placeholder source/notes detected
interpretation_notes: Converts monetary shocks into direct and total jobs estimates.
quality_caveats: This is a high-sensitivity dataset; proxy values can create suspiciously uniform regional jobs outputs.
expert_action_required: Development economist should calibrate by region/sector and document source/method.

name: Value-added intensity table
lifecycle: Static calibration table, should cite source year
schema_or_key_columns: mario_region; mario_sector; gva_per_musd_output; household_income_per_musd_output; reference_year; source; notes
units: million USD GVA or household income per million USD output
temporal_resolution: reference_year plus run target year assumption
placeholder_status: Strict-blocking if placeholder rows and allow_placeholder_data=false
validation_rules: Numeric intensities required; placeholders detected by source/notes
interpretation_notes: Converts monetary shocks into GVA and household income proxy estimates.
quality_caveats: Proxy values can overstate local benefits if import leakage is not represented.
expert_action_required: MRIO expert should calibrate by latest database and inflation/currency basis.

name: Scenario assumptions table
consumer: integrated indicator builder and environment validation
schema_or_key_columns: assumption_key; scenario_key; value; unit; effective_year; source; notes
units: varies by assumption; numeric value parsed where possible
temporal_resolution: effective_year; scenario selection falls back baseline/default
spatial_resolution: scenario/global unless assumption key implies geography
source_or_provenance: Expert assumptions outside energy model boundary
placeholder_status: Strict-blocking if selected placeholder rows and allow_placeholder_data=false
validation_rules: Assumption keys required; scenario_key selection ranks exact over baseline over default; numeric parsing where needed
interpretation_notes: Provides non-energy assumptions for integrated indicators and narrative interpretation.
quality_caveats: Could overlap with report-derived MRIO-direct assumptions; provenance should distinguish table vs DOCX report.
update_frequency: When scenario narratives or indicator assumptions change
expert_action_required: Analyst should reconcile with report parser output and remove placeholders.

name: Development indicator mapping
required: Optional but needed for rich reporting
schema_or_key_columns: indicator_id; indicator_name; driver_metric; aggregation_rule; unit; lag_years; notes
sector_technology_resolution: maps to modeled metrics, not necessarily sectors
placeholder_status: May be placeholder but not strict-blocking by default
validation_rules: indicator_id required; driver_metric should match integrated outputs or becomes unavailable
interpretation_notes: Maps model outputs into named development indicators for dashboard/reporting.
quality_caveats: Unavailable mappings reduce model quality and reporting completeness.
expert_action_required: Development/product team should maintain definitions and avoid vague metrics.

name: Exchange output schema
schema_or_key_columns: file_name; column_name; required; dtype; description
validation_rules: Required files/columns must exist after bridge generation
interpretation_notes: Validates bridge artifacts before/while running development layer.
quality_caveats: Schema can lag actual files if new bridge artifacts are added.
expert_action_required: Backend/MRIO team should update schema and tests together.

name: World fit GeoJSON
consumer: frontend map rendering and spatial filters
lifecycle: Static asset; replace with expert GIS source if placeholder
schema_or_key_columns: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; country/subregion properties; geometries
spatial_resolution: country or subcountry polygons as available
placeholder_status: May be placeholder; must be verified for production
validation_rules: Valid GeoJSON; geometry properties must join to model region/country codes
interpretation_notes: Provides polygon boundaries for map display and selection.
quality_caveats: Incorrect joins produce wrong highlighting/filtering even if model data is correct.
expert_action_required: Procure authoritative GeoJSON with stable ISO/calliope join keys and license metadata.

name: EDIM placeholder location GeoJSON
lifecycle: Temporary placeholder until authoritative subregion file arrives
schema_or_key_columns: GeoJSON points or features with EDIM location codes and lat/lon
source_or_provenance: Placeholder generated for EDIM location visualization
validation_rules: Must be valid GeoJSON; coordinates should be within parent country; properties must join to Calliope locations
interpretation_notes: Feeds centroid/Voronoi representative areas when polygon subregions are not available.
quality_caveats: Representative points are a visualization approximation, not a true administrative boundary.
update_frequency: Temporary until real GIS file exists
expert_action_required: Replace with authoritative subnational geometry or vetted centroids.

name: Country geometry manifest
schema_or_key_columns: country code to topology asset path and metadata
placeholder_status: Not placeholder if source geometry is acceptable
validation_rules: Manifest paths must exist; codes should align with ISO_A3 used by model/geography mapping
interpretation_notes: Allows lazy loading or cataloging of country geometries.
quality_caveats: Manifest completeness does not imply subnational resolution.
expert_action_required: GIS/frontend team should regenerate and validate manifest.

name: Per-country TopoJSON boundaries
schema_or_key_columns: TopoJSON topology per ISO-like code
spatial_resolution: country-level topology; may include internal properties depending source
placeholder_status: Unknown; verify license/source before external use
validation_rules: Each manifest file should parse and match expected code
interpretation_notes: Provides map outlines and fallback boundaries for countries.
quality_caveats: May not include the subnational boundaries needed for highest model resolution.
expert_action_required: GIS team should document source, simplification tolerance, and license.

name: Architecture design spec
consumer: Architecture tab renderer and handoff documentation
required: Optional for model execution; required for architecture tab
schema_or_key_columns: sections; layers; flows; data contracts; UI guidance depending spec
validation_rules: Must parse as JSON; frontend copy should remain in sync with root copy
interpretation_notes: Drives the architecture/spec tab added to the EDIM app.
quality_caveats: Can drift from implemented code if not maintained with features.
expert_action_required: Keep spec synchronized with implemented runtime and handoff docs.

name: Runtime environment variables
path_or_pattern: Environment: EDIM_SOLVER, EDIM_DEVELOPMENT_ENGINE, EDIM_* profile settings, OPENAI_API_KEY if used
required: Yes for solver/runtime behavior; API key only for optional features
schema_or_key_columns: solver; development_engine; run profile subset windows; time limits; queue/retention; optional paths
placeholder_status: Not placeholder; local defaults may be dev-oriented
validation_rules: Values must be parseable by settings; solver must be available; full-year must be explicitly allowed if disabled
interpretation_notes: Controls solver selection, development engine mode, queue limits, run retention, and strict runtime behavior.
quality_caveats: Environment drift is a common source of “works on my machine” differences.
expert_action_required: Document deployment values and keep dev/analysis/full profiles intentional.

name: Unified scenario package artifact
consumer: Energy adapter, MRIO-direct adapter, diagnostics, UI/API result payload
schema_or_key_columns: schema_version; created_at_utc; energy_scenario_key; mrio_scenario_id; target_year; run_profile; levers; strict_validation; allow_placeholder_data; energy; mrio_direct; geography_alignment; provenance
spatial_resolution: MRIO geography plus mapped Calliope locations
sector_technology_resolution: energy scenario and MRIO scenario metadata
source_or_provenance: Integrated request plus report cache plus geography mapping
placeholder_status: None; reflects request and parsed inputs
validation_rules: Must be written before model execution; geography_alignment.blocking_mismatch must be false
interpretation_notes: Primary inspectable contract showing what the run meant. This is the artifact teams should start from when debugging a result.
quality_caveats: Package validity does not mean numeric outputs are calibrated.
related_artifacts: IN-001 to IN-008; OUT-002 to OUT-006; OUT-029
expert_action_required: Keep stable enough for downstream debugging and attach to reports/exports.

name: Energy input manifest
schema_or_key_columns: adapter; model; scenario_key
validation_rules: Must include adapter=calliope_v1 and scenario key
interpretation_notes: Records the energy-side adapter decision that feeds Calliope.
quality_caveats: Currently a manifest, not a full materialized Calliope model dump.
expert_action_required: If OSeMOSYS is added, extend schema without overloading Calliope fields.

name: Report scenario reference artifact
schema_or_key_columns: scenario_id; geography_code; geography; scenario_type; label; summary; shock_categories; notes
temporal_resolution: target years contained in scenario reference
source_or_provenance: Copied from parsed scenario report cache
placeholder_status: None, but heuristic interpretation must be labeled
validation_rules: Must match mrio_scenario_id in scenario_package
interpretation_notes: Freezes the report-derived MRIO scenario used by the run.
quality_caveats: If report parser missed content, this artifact will also be incomplete.
expert_action_required: Analysts should review this after report changes.

name: Geography alignment artifact
consumer: MRIO-direct adapter, UI diagnostics, map filters
schema_or_key_columns: status; blocking_mismatch; mrio_geography_code; mrio_geography; calliope_locations[]; calliope_location_count; alignment_level; mapping_rows; notes
source_or_provenance: Derived from scenario_geography_mapping.csv and Calliope locations
placeholder_status: None; mapping quality depends on source table
validation_rules: blocking_mismatch false; selected locations should be nonempty for aligned scenarios unless MRIO-only is intentional
interpretation_notes: Shows how national/regional MRIO assumptions were applied to Calliope geographies.
quality_caveats: If status=mrio_only, map and regional development attribution need careful interpretation.
expert_action_required: Audit if new report geography or Calliope subregion appears.

name: MRIO-direct inputs artifact
consumer: Development layer, UI source-channel panel, model quality diagnostics
generated_or_manual: Generated per run after bridge reference total is known
schema_or_key_columns: schema_version; method; scenario_id; target_year; geography_code; bridge_total_reference_musd; configuration; shock_rows[]; totals; diagnostics
units: million USD shock values; emissions proxy delta
spatial_resolution: MRIO geography code and geography object
sector_technology_resolution: MARIO proxy sectors and A/Z,E,Y categories
source_or_provenance: Parsed report plus bridge total reference plus development_model config
placeholder_status: Heuristic v1; model quality cannot exceed analyst_review while active
validation_rules: shock rows must contain category, region, sector, target_year, shock_value_musd, method; capped if direct total exceeds max ratio
interpretation_notes: Converts report assumptions outside the energy boundary into direct MRIO shock rows while preserving provenance.
quality_caveats: Heuristic rows are not a full MARIO matrix shock execution; do not treat as final empirical IO result.
expert_action_required: Replace heuristic formulas with actual A/Z/E/Y matrix shock execution when MARIO database integration is ready.

name: MRIO-direct shock rows CSV
consumer: Analysts, UI source-channel panel, downstream MRIO tooling
schema_or_key_columns: shock_category; parameter; mario_parameter; mario_region; geography; mario_sector; target_year; shock_value_musd; method; notes
validation_rules: Numeric shock_value_musd; categories align to A/Z, E, Y; method label required
interpretation_notes: Flat inspectable version of MRIO-direct shock assumptions.
quality_caveats: May not be consumed by an external MARIO engine yet; currently supports built-in heuristic layer/diagnostics.
expert_action_required: Use as review table for MRIO experts before implementing exact matrix shocks.

name: Runtime UI/lever override patch
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope override_dict structure for solver, profile subset_time, levers
units: Calliope-native units; seconds for time limits
spatial_resolution: applies across selected Calliope model scope
validation_rules: Must be parseable YAML; should not mutate source Calliope files
interpretation_notes: Shows exactly what runtime patch was applied in addition to selected energy scenario.
quality_caveats: Not a complete model; only delta patch.
expert_action_required: Review when lever effects seem absent or unexpected.

name: Raw/flattened Calliope results table
consumer: summary builder, bridge builder, UI/API downloads
schema_or_key_columns: variable-like columns as emitted by runner from Calliope xarray results; includes dimensions such as tech/location/time where available
temporal_resolution: model timestep or aggregated depending extracted variable
source_or_provenance: Solved Calliope model using integrated energy scenario and overrides
validation_rules: Should be nonempty unless no result variables; parseable CSV
interpretation_notes: Primary flat export of energy model outputs.
quality_caveats: Column schema may evolve with Calliope version and extraction logic; use summary artifacts for stable dashboard fields.
expert_action_required: If downstream tools need stability, formalize this CSV schema.

name: Run summary API/file payload
consumer: Frontend dashboard, API clients, report builder
schema_or_key_columns: run_id; energy_scenario_key; mrio_scenario_id; target_year; run_profile; warnings; scenario_package; generation_by_tech; capacity_by_tech; new_capacity_by_tech; system_cost; emissions; summary_diagnostics; development_impacts; exchange_artifacts; integrated_results; coupling_manifest; scenario_assumptions; development_indicators
units: mixed energy, emissions, cost, jobs, GVA units
temporal_resolution: target year plus model timestep aggregations in diagnostics
spatial_resolution: global, location, pool, region depending metric
sector_technology_resolution: technology, carrier, supplier sector depending metric
source_or_provenance: Composed from model outputs, diagnostics, development runtime, integrated builder
placeholder_status: None, but may contain warnings about placeholders/heuristics
validation_rules: Must satisfy RunSummary Pydantic shape; warnings should be retained
interpretation_notes: Main backend output consumed by dashboard and reports.
quality_caveats: Mixed resolution object: users must inspect metric_resolution/source channel metadata for correct filtering.
expert_action_required: Keep as stable as possible for frontend; add explicit schema versions if external clients consume it.

name: Summary diagnostics object
consumer: Frontend charts, integrated results, bridge fallback weighting
schema_or_key_columns: reliability; energy_balance; physical_emissions; cost_decomposition; trade_matrix; system_structure; run_metadata and related diagnostic records
units: MWh/GWh-like energy units; tCO2; USD; shares; counts
temporal_resolution: model timestep aggregations and run metadata
spatial_resolution: global, location, power pool depending metric
source_or_provenance: Derived from Calliope results.csv/xarray result variables
validation_rules: Should include source/resolution where feasible; must not label regional values as country if native resolution differs
interpretation_notes: Provides detailed diagnostic basis for costs, emissions, reliability, trade, and model structure.
quality_caveats: Some metrics are global only or have non-country native resolution; frontend must respect metric_resolution.
expert_action_required: Continue expanding explicit unit/resolution metadata per metric.

name: Calliope component activity exchange
schema_or_key_columns: technology; carrier; region/location; activity/value columns depending bridge extraction
temporal_resolution: aggregated run period or target-year proxy
validation_rules: Must satisfy exchange_output_schema where declared
interpretation_notes: Inspectable bridge table of model activity used to derive shocks.
quality_caveats: Schema should be kept explicit; activity-to-economic shock interpretation requires mapping tables.
expert_action_required: Formalize units and aggregation period in metadata.json if not already explicit.

name: Investment shocks exchange
consumer: MARIO runtime and MRIO-direct reference total
schema_or_key_columns: region; mario_sector; technology; shock_value_musd and related fields
spatial_resolution: MARIO region mapped from Calliope location
sector_technology_resolution: MARIO supplier sector and Calliope technology
source_or_provenance: Calliope cost decomposition plus CAPEX split mapping
validation_rules: Required columns validated by exchange_output_schema; positive shock values used by runtime
interpretation_notes: Represents bridge-derived capital/investment demand shocks from the energy model.
quality_caveats: Bridge-derived values are currently authoritative over overlapping MRIO-direct headline totals.
expert_action_required: Verify currency basis and whether costs are annualized vs overnight before policy interpretation.

name: Operating shocks exchange
schema_or_key_columns: region; mario_sector; technology; opex_type; shock_value_musd and related fields
spatial_resolution: MARIO region mapped from Calliope location
sector_technology_resolution: MARIO supplier sector, Calliope technology, OPEX type
source_or_provenance: Calliope cost decomposition plus OPEX split mapping
validation_rules: Required columns validated by exchange_output_schema; positive shock values used by runtime
interpretation_notes: Represents bridge-derived operating expenditure shocks from the energy model.
quality_caveats: OPEX timing/annualization assumptions must be documented for interpretation.
expert_action_required: MRIO expert should confirm OPEX sector split and time basis.

name: Energy service balance exchange
consumer: Analysts, diagnostics, potential MRIO demand channel
schema_or_key_columns: region/location; carrier/service; production/consumption/balance fields depending bridge builder
source_or_provenance: Derived from solved Calliope energy balances
validation_rules: Should parse and be internally balanced within tolerance where applicable
interpretation_notes: Supports diagnostics about energy service changes feeding development interpretation.
quality_caveats: Not necessarily a direct monetary MRIO shock by itself.
expert_action_required: Clarify whether balance values are annualized or subset-time scaled.

name: Prices and taxes exchange
consumer: Analysts and potential MRIO price/tax channel
required: Yes if price/tax fields available; may be sparse
schema_or_key_columns: region/location; component/account; price/tax fields depending bridge builder
units: USD, USD/tCO2, or model-native monetary units
source_or_provenance: Derived from Calliope costs and lever carbon price
validation_rules: Should parse; missing fields should be represented with diagnostics/warnings
interpretation_notes: Captures bridge-side price/tax assumptions such as carbon price effects.
quality_caveats: May not yet feed full MARIO price-shock execution.
expert_action_required: Define exact downstream MRIO price/tax interpretation before using for policy claims.

name: Exchange metadata
schema_or_key_columns: run_id; scenario; year; bridge method; source files; schema validation; shock totals and diagnostics as implemented
validation_rules: Should identify source tables and validation status
interpretation_notes: Documents the exchange bundle contents and bridge generation details.
quality_caveats: If metadata omits unit/time basis, external users may misread shocks.
expert_action_required: Expand if new exchange channels are added.

name: MARIO runtime direct output before MRIO-direct attachment
required: Yes when MARIO engine mode is active
schema_or_key_columns: run_id; scenario; method=mario_io_runtime_v1; inputs; totals; uncertainty; by_region; by_supplier_sector; by_region_supplier; diagnostics; metadata
temporal_resolution: target year; reference years in intensity tables
source_or_provenance: Bridge shocks plus employment/value-added intensity tables
placeholder_status: None if inputs calibrated; may reflect placeholder intensity data
validation_rules: Requires required MARIO input tables; handles empty/non-positive shocks with zero payload and warnings
interpretation_notes: Bridge-channel development impacts before adding MRIO-direct source channel.
quality_caveats: Built-in IO runtime is simplified relative to full MARIO database matrix execution.
expert_action_required: Replace/extend with exact MARIO database results when available.

name: Development impacts combined payload
consumer: Frontend development panels, integrated results, reports
schema_or_key_columns: bridge; mrio_direct; selected_totals; combined_totals; overlap_diagnostics; totals; uncertainty; by_region; by_supplier_sector; by_region_supplier; diagnostics; metadata
temporal_resolution: target year; intensity reference years in source tables
source_or_provenance: Bridge runtime plus MRIO-direct heuristic inputs
placeholder_status: MRIO-direct is heuristic; bridge channel quality depends on expert tables
validation_rules: selected_totals defaults to bridge on overlap; overlap_diagnostics must clearly flag temporary policy
interpretation_notes: Main development impact object. It keeps source channels separate while exposing a bridge-authoritative selected total for headlines.
quality_caveats: Do not sum selected_totals and mrio_direct totals for headlines without understanding overlap.
expert_action_required: MRIO expert should review overlap list and replace heuristic merge policy later.

name: Exchange copy of development impacts
schema_or_key_columns: Same logical schema as OUT-018
validation_rules: Must stay consistent with root development_impacts.json
interpretation_notes: Puts combined development impact payload inside exchange folder for bundle completeness.
quality_caveats: Duplicate copy can drift only if writer changes; tests should ensure consistency.
expert_action_required: Keep root and exchange copies synchronized.

name: Coupling manifest
lifecycle: One per run, plus exchange copy
schema_or_key_columns: development_engine_mode; mapping coverage; runtime metadata; integration_architecture; energy_scenario_key; mrio_scenario_id; target_year; mrio_direct_method; mrio_direct_heuristic; selected_totals_source; temporary_overlap_policy; report_source; geography_alignment
placeholder_status: None, but may report heuristic/placeholder/fallback warnings
validation_rules: Should flag temporary overlap policy and mrio_direct_heuristic true when active
interpretation_notes: Primary coupling/provenance artifact explaining how energy, bridge, and MRIO-direct layers were connected.
quality_caveats: If this says bridge_authoritative_for_headline_totals, users should not interpret MRIO-direct as additive headline output.
expert_action_required: Maintain as the audit trail for integration decisions.

name: Integrated results payload
schema_or_key_columns: run_id; scenario; scenario_package; headline_metrics; development_drivers; regional_development; development_confidence; development_uncertainty; baseline_comparison; development_indicators; model_quality; metric_resolution; source_channels; scenario_provenance
units: jobs; GVA/income million USD; emissions; reliability shares; metadata
sector_technology_resolution: technology, supplier sector, indicator depending section
source_or_provenance: Run summary, development impacts, assumptions, coupling manifest
placeholder_status: Contains heuristic and quality flags where active
validation_rules: validate_integrated_results checks required fields/types; model_quality should cap status if MRIO-direct heuristic active
interpretation_notes: Most complete dashboard/report payload with provenance and source channel comparison.
quality_caveats: Consumers must honor metric_resolution and source_channels instead of assuming all fields filter to country level.
expert_action_required: Treat this as primary API for frontend; add schema version if externalized.

name: Exchange copy of integrated results
schema_or_key_columns: Same logical schema as OUT-021
validation_rules: Must stay consistent with root integrated_results.json
interpretation_notes: Makes integrated result available inside exchange bundle.
quality_caveats: Duplicate copy should be kept synchronized.
expert_action_required: Keep exchange and root copy synchronized.

name: Run report markdown
schema_or_key_columns: Markdown sections for run summary, model quality, coupling, metric resolution, indicators, source channels, warnings
validation_rules: Should include scenario package/provenance and quality issues
interpretation_notes: Human-readable report for handoff and review.
quality_caveats: Should not be treated as raw data source; use JSON/CSV artifacts for computation.
expert_action_required: Review narrative text for clarity and update as architecture evolves.

name: Legacy NetCDF results file
producer: Calliope/runner in older or optional run paths
schema_or_key_columns: Calliope xarray dataset variables/dimensions
validation_rules: Must be readable as NetCDF/xarray if present
interpretation_notes: High-fidelity native-like result export for technical users.
quality_caveats: Not primary dashboard contract and may not exist in all runs.
expert_action_required: If needed, formalize whether current runner should always write it.

name: Exchange bundle archive
schema_or_key_columns: ZIP containing exchange CSVs, metadata, development/integrated JSON, coupling manifest, possibly report files
validation_rules: Archive should include expected exchange files; no path traversal; valid ZIP
interpretation_notes: Portable bundle for downstream review or transfer.
quality_caveats: Archive completeness depends on writer include list.
expert_action_required: Update packager when adding stable run artifacts.

name: Job info/list API response
schema_or_key_columns: job_id; status; progress; stage; message; queue_position; created_at; started_at; finished_at; updated_at; worker_pid; error; request; artifacts; summary
source_or_provenance: Job manager state plus run artifacts
validation_rules: Must satisfy JobInfo/JobListResponse schema
interpretation_notes: Tracks asynchronous run execution and exposes final summary/artifacts.
quality_caveats: If summary is large, frontend performance should be watched.
expert_action_required: Frontend should handle queued/running/failed/complete states explicitly.

name: Environment setup/readiness report
schema_or_key_columns: ok; generated_at_utc; energy_scenario_key; mrio_scenario_id; target_year; run_profile; strict_validation; allow_placeholder_data; solver_requested/resolved; development_engine; queue; mario_inputs; checks[]; warnings[]; errors[]
spatial_resolution: global readiness; validates selected scenario geographies
sector_technology_resolution: mapping coverage and tech counts where available
source_or_provenance: Settings, files, scenario package validation, MARIO health
placeholder_status: Flags placeholder data and strict validation status
validation_rules: Errors block readiness; checks categorized calliope/controls/runtime/mario
interpretation_notes: Explains whether a run is likely to execute before submission.
quality_caveats: A passing readiness report still does not validate scientific calibration quality fully.
expert_action_required: Use in UI to surface blockers before users spend time on runs.

name: MARIO runtime log
required: Yes for debugging when MARIO stage runs
schema_or_key_columns: runtime metadata, warnings, errors, paths, timing depending writer payload
validation_rules: Should be parseable if JSON log; retain errors/warnings
interpretation_notes: Debug log for development engine execution.
quality_caveats: Not a stable user-facing API contract.
expert_action_required: Keep enough diagnostics to reproduce runtime failures.

name: Scenario provenance panel data
schema_or_key_columns: package; report_source; energy_scenario_key; mrio_scenario_id; target_year; levers; geography_alignment
validation_rules: Should mirror OUT-001 and OUT-020
interpretation_notes: Provides UI-ready provenance for what scenario was run and where assumptions came from.
quality_caveats: Should not duplicate contradictory fields; if conflict, scenario_package should be canonical.
expert_action_required: Use this for dashboard provenance rather than reconstructing from scattered fields.

name: Frontend derived map selection/filter layer
path_or_pattern: Rendered in browser from frontend/geo assets plus summary/integrated result data
consumer: User, all dashboard tabs, chart filters
schema_or_key_columns: feature geometry; join keys; selected country/subregion; derived Voronoi polygons from centroid points where needed; metric values by selected variable
units: map metric units vary by selected variable; lon/lat geometry
temporal_resolution: static geometry plus selected run target year
spatial_resolution: country/subcountry/location/pool depending available geometry and metric_resolution
sector_technology_resolution: selected metric may be tech/sector aggregated
placeholder_status: Placeholder if using edim_locations_placeholder centroid/Voronoi approximations
validation_rules: Feature join keys must match result records; selected highlight should emphasize selected country/subregion; metric_resolution must govern filtering
interpretation_notes: Provides spatial interaction, highlighting, and chart filtering across the dashboard.
quality_caveats: Voronoi areas from centroids are representative visual regions, not administrative boundaries.
expert_action_required: Replace placeholder centroid Voronoi with authoritative boundaries when procured.

name: Frontend rendered dashboard panels
path_or_pattern: Browser DOM from frontend/app.jsx using API payloads
schema_or_key_columns: panels for integrated scenario definition, global/regional/country boxes, map, source-channel comparison, bridge inputs, MRIO-direct assumptions, overlap warning, charts
source_or_provenance: API responses and static frontend assets
placeholder_status: None, but can display placeholder warnings
validation_rules: Must not call hooks conditionally; charts should respect selected geography and metric_resolution
interpretation_notes: Primary user interpretation surface for model outputs.
quality_caveats: UI can mislead if it hides global-only metrics or source-channel overlap warnings.
example_values: Generation by technology; Capacity; Development impacts
expert_action_required: Design/frontend team should keep dashboard non-scroll-first and clear about resolution/source channels.

name: Source channel comparison object
schema_or_key_columns: bridge; mrio_direct; selected_totals; combined_totals; overlap_diagnostics
validation_rules: Must expose overlap_diagnostics and selected_totals source
interpretation_notes: Shows bridge-derived vs MRIO-direct results side by side and the temporary overlap policy.
quality_caveats: combined_totals may be useful diagnostically but should not be confused with authoritative headlines.
expert_action_required: Keep warning copy explicit until merge logic is removed.

name: Model quality object
schema_or_key_columns: status; score; summary; issues[]; flags including mrio_direct_heuristic
spatial_resolution: global quality assessment, with issue-specific scope
sector_technology_resolution: not sector-specific unless issue text says so
source_or_provenance: Integrated results, diagnostics, coupling manifest, indicator availability
validation_rules: If mrio_direct_heuristic true, status cannot exceed analyst_review
interpretation_notes: Summarizes whether outputs are ready for analyst review or production-like interpretation.
quality_caveats: A single score is reductive; always inspect issues list.
expert_action_required: Add domain-specific validation tests as model matures.

name: Metric resolution object
schema_or_key_columns: records[].metric_id; label; native_resolution; filtered_resolution; filter_policy; caveats
validation_rules: Frontend should use this to prevent false country filtering for global-only metrics
interpretation_notes: Explains which outputs can be filtered to selected country/subcountry and which must stay in global boxes.
quality_caveats: Must be maintained as new charts/metrics are added.
expert_action_required: Keep aligned with every dashboard chart and data card.

name: Baseline comparison object
schema_or_key_columns: baseline scenario reference; metric deltas; percentage changes depending implementation
source_or_provenance: Current run summary plus baseline summary if available
validation_rules: Should clearly identify baseline source and missing baseline conditions
interpretation_notes: Shows change vs a baseline scenario when available.
quality_caveats: Invalid if baseline run/scenario differs in geography/profile in a way not disclosed.
expert_action_required: Define canonical baseline selection for each report scenario.

name: Regional/supplier development records
path_or_pattern: development_impacts.by_region, by_supplier_sector, by_region_supplier and integrated regional_development
schema_or_key_columns: region; supplier_sector; shock_value_musd; jobs_direct; jobs_total; gva_total_musd; household_income_proxy_musd
source_or_provenance: Bridge shocks plus intensity tables; MRIO-direct has separate source channel records
validation_rules: Records sorted/truncated to configured max rows; region UNKNOWN should be treated as a data issue
interpretation_notes: Supports development impacts by supplier sector and geography.
quality_caveats: Uniform values can indicate fallback intensities or mapping gaps; investigate diagnostics.
expert_action_required: Keep regional mappings and intensities calibrated to avoid false precision.

name: Development indicators object
required: Optional but expected for complete dashboard
schema_or_key_columns: records[]; available_count; unavailable_count; warnings; each record indicator_id, indicator_name, driver_metric, value, unit, source_paths/status
placeholder_status: Can include unavailable indicators if mapping not supported
validation_rules: Unavailable count should be exposed; model_quality uses it
interpretation_notes: Translates raw model metrics into named development indicators.
quality_caveats: Indicator interpretation depends on mapping quality and assumptions; not all indicators are directly modeled.
expert_action_required: Development team should keep indicators traceable and avoid unsupported claims.

name: Selected scenario assumptions object
schema_or_key_columns: path; exists; requested_scenario; run_year; records[]; selected_values; selected_count; placeholder counts/examples
validation_rules: Selected exact scenario over baseline/default; placeholder row counts preserved
interpretation_notes: Shows which non-energy assumption table rows were selected.
quality_caveats: This is separate from DOCX report-derived MRIO-direct assumptions.
expert_action_required: Clarify relationship to report-derived assumptions in UI copy.

name: Development confidence object
schema_or_key_columns: coupling_mode; mapping_coverage_share; fallback_mapping_share; warnings_count; mario_runtime_executed; mario_runtime_seconds; development_indicators_available_count; mrio_direct_method; selected_totals_source; temporary_overlap_policy and related fields
validation_rules: Should include temporary overlap policy when active
interpretation_notes: Compact confidence/diagnostics block for development results.
quality_caveats: Not a substitute for detailed model_quality issues.
expert_action_required: Frontend should surface this near development impact charts.

name: Rendered architecture tab
path_or_pattern: Second top-level EDIM web app tab loading architecture.html/js/spec
required: Optional for model execution; required for project handoff UI
schema_or_key_columns: architecture sections, diagrams, design spec content
validation_rules: Spec JSON must parse; tab routing should not break dashboard hooks
interpretation_notes: Provides in-app technical architecture/design reference for teams carrying the project forward.
quality_caveats: Can drift from code if not updated with implementation changes.
expert_action_required: Make documentation updates part of feature completion criteria.
